payload.content_text: Optimize my portfolio for growth with low risk. GrowthAgent wants to increase technology sector exposure. RiskAgent wants to reduce volatility by diversifying. ExecutionAgent wants to rebalance immediately. The agents keep making conflicting trades and the portfolio oscillates without converging on a stable state. The agents must agree on a single portfolio objective that balances growth and risk, on the conditions that trigger a rebalance, and on the sector concentration limits that all three agents will respect — so that trades move the portfolio toward a coherent target rather than cancelling each other out.

growth: maximize returns without a specific target
low risk: no more than 5% drawdown in a month
volatility: beta below 1 relative to the market
diversifying: limit any single sector to 25% of portfolio
rebalance immediately: rebalance only when conditions are met
single portfolio objective: achieve a balance of 50% growth and 50% risk reduction
conditions that trigger a rebalance: sector allocation exceeds 5% deviation from target
